title: Binary Tree Paths
inputFormat: Implement binaryTreePaths(root). The runner converts the level-order input array into nodes with val, left, and right fields; [] becomes null.
outputFormat: An array of root-to-leaf path strings joined with ->, in any order. A leaf has no children.

visuals.title: Stop only at a leaf
visuals.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 380 255" role="img" aria-label="Tree with root 1, left child 2 with right child 5, and right child 3" style="width:100%;height:auto;max-width:380px;color:var(--color-text)"><path d="M190 30L95 105" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><path d="M190 30L285 105" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><path d="M95 105L145 180" stroke="var(--color-text-light)" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/><circle cx="190" cy="30" r="21" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="190" y="36" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">1</text><circle cx="95" cy="105" r="21" fill="var(--color-surface)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="95" y="111" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">2</text><circle cx="285" cy="105" r="21" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="285" y="111" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">3</text><circle cx="145" cy="180" r="21" fill="var(--dc-sage)" stroke="currentColor"/><text x="145" y="186" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="monospace" font-size="18">5</text><text x="190" y="220" text-anchor="middle" fill="currentColor" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="16">Paths: 1 → 2 → 5 and 1 → 3</text></svg>
visuals.caption: Nodes 5 and 3 are leaves. The path 1 → 2 is incomplete because 2 still has a child.
